page.heading: Frankenstein
page.dek: The first glimpse of a life brought into the world.
page.featureAriaLabel: 1831 Frankenstein frontispiece and a passage from the novel

image.alt: Victor Frankenstein recoils from his creation, frontispiece to the 1831 edition
image.caption: Theodor von Holst · 1831 edition

reference.bio: First published anonymously in 1818, Shelley’s novel follows a young student who discovers how to give life to inanimate matter. Its Gothic dread turns scientific ambition into a question of moral responsibility.

quote.text: I saw the dull yellow eye of the creature open; it breathed hard.
